newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel extends sale date of yard.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel extends sale date of yard.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp said Monday it is continuing talks with Baltimore Shipbuilding and Drydock LLC over the sale of its BethShip Sparrows Point Yard in Maryland.
The company said it hoped that the sale, whose deadline was Monday June 30, would be finalized soon.
The company said it announced plans to sell the yard in October as part of a comprehensive restructuring plan and that if the yard could not be sold it would be shut down.

On Monday it said it would be cutting its hourly workforce to those employees who are needed in the near term for completing certain miscellaneous maintenance-related work, and extended the June 30 shutdown date until July 14.

"We hope that a transaction can be finalized in the very near future. The sale transaction involves numerous complex business issues, some of which have not yet been resolved," the company said in a statement.
